method: Each point starts fresh daemons and namespaces. Delivered rates are receiver sum_received bits_per_second. Retransmits are iperf3 sender totals, not an exact loss ratio. Daemon/thread CPU is before/after proc user+system ticks at CLK_TCK=100 divided by snapshot wall time; 100% is one core. Iperf CPU is reported independently. Raw snapshots and per-stream results are retained. No local build, kernel test or Git packing overlapped load.
limitations: One twenty-second observation per build/stream-count; no five-run acceptance claim.
TCP congestion control limits offered load, so this does not prove the unlimited UDP overload plateau.
No injected delay or loss; real NGN target unverified.
